summary: Physio On Queen has loyal patients: some have followed Simo for nearly eight years, and Ziad's sessions get described as a real before and after. But nearby clinics open at 7am and have more than twice your reviews, so new patients often find them first.
visibility: In our searches your own website did not appear, even for your exact name and address. Medimap lists you on eleven separate pages, one per service, and nearby competitors appear for general physiotherapy searches.
lead: Deep loyalty: patients have followed Simo for almost eight years.
Hands-on 45-minute sessions that patients describe as transformative.
lose: Nearby clinics open from 7am; you open at 10am.
New patients can't see your hands-on approach before they choose.

gaps.title: Your clinic is scattered across a dozen pages
gaps.detail: Searching your name returned eleven separate Medimap pages and a health directory, but not your own website. New patients can't see everything you offer, from physio to osteopathy and naturopathy, in one place.

gaps.title: Before-work patients go elsewhere
gaps.detail: Downtown workers want 7–9am appointments. If they can't see when you're free, they book a clinic that shows it.

gaps.title: Your loyal patients could bring more
gaps.detail: Patients who've stayed eight years are your best marketing. An automatic review request and a referral message would grow your reviews fast.

actions.title: Ask loyal patients for reviews and referrals
actions.why: Doable today: a short message to your regulars closes the review gap.

actions.title: Show your hands-on approach
actions.why: Ziad's and Simo's style is your difference; make it visible before patients book.

actions.title: Let patients book online
actions.why: Real-time availability wins patients who would otherwise call another clinic.

plan.title: Your new website with online booking
plan.detail: Your team and approach, with real-time availability.

plan.title: Review and referral requests
plan.detail: Automatic messages that turn loyal patients into new ones.

plan.title: Check-ins after discharge
plan.detail: Gentle follow-ups that bring patients back before the pain does.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: How you compare with downtown clinics, and what to do next.
